### Added

- (bot-prs) [Show sweep progress and keep long sweeps alive](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2936) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — On the Bot PRs page, `Classify now`, `Approve and merge` and the sweep dialog show how far marge has got for each team, such as `34 of 79 PRs done`, and no longer fail on a large queue while marge is still working. Needs a muster and marge that report progress; without them the page behaves as before.

### Development and CI/CD

- (ci) [Align files according to platform standards](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2935) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot]) — Generated update of the shared project-board workflow.
